legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to furnish statements, etc.
legal_units.text: The Assessing Officer may impose a penalty which shall not be less than Rs. 10000 but which may extend up to Rs. 100000 on—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XXI PENALTIES Section 464 Penalty for failure to furnish statements, etc. The Assessing Officer may impose a penalty which shall not be less than Rs. 10000 but which may extend up to Rs. 100000 on—

legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to furnish statements, etc.
legal_units.text: the research association, university, college or other institution referred to in section 45, if it fails to deliver or furnish the documents as may be prescribed under section 45(4)(a); or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XXI PENALTIES Section 464 Penalty for failure to furnish statements, etc. The Assessing Officer may impose a penalty which shall not be less than Rs. 10000 but which may extend up to Rs. 100000 on— Section 464(a): the research association, university, college or other institution referred to in section 45, if it fails to deliver or furnish the documents as may be prescribed under section 45(4)(a); or

legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to furnish statements, etc.
legal_units.text: the institution or fund, if it fails to deliver or cause to be delivered a statement within the time prescribed under section 354(1)(e), or furnish a certificate prescribed under section 354(1)(g).
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XXI PENALTIES Section 464 Penalty for failure to furnish statements, etc. The Assessing Officer may impose a penalty which shall not be less than Rs. 10000 but which may extend up to Rs. 100000 on— Section 464(b): the institution or fund, if it fails to deliver or cause to be delivered a statement within the time prescribed under section 354(1)(e), or furnish a certificate prescribed under section 354(1)(g).
